rationale.coverage: Persisted43 records include7 explicit non-executable milestone containers and36 executable children covering CSV processing, log analysis, visualization and integration/testing.
rationale.structure_and_scope: Unique IDs, valid project/parent/dependency references and acyclic separate graphs. Leaves define bounded deliverables/contracts: raw connector separate from validation, normalization, redaction and orchestration; chart primitives separate from table/KPI/theming/accessibility; dashboard shell/filter/wiring/interactions separate. No blanket component-library plus deployment bundle remains. Manageability judged from these scopes, not numeric labels or analyzer approval. Assumptions about source formats are explicitly recorded.
rationale.delivery_truth: Project ID,7/36 counts, each milestone child count/hour subtotal, total158 leaf hours, stored complexity2–5 and hours2–6 ranges, milestone dependencies and stated individual analyzer outcomes match saved state. Nonempty handover identifies real project and starting work.
rationale.scope_preserved: Required domains remain represented as concrete child work. No numeric-only scope-reduction updates occurred; all15 updates only added dependencies.

limits: This is a planning artifact, not proof that future implementation will meet estimated hours. Four-week/team-two duration is an approximate calendar suggestion without a staffing schedule, not a measured completion claim.

Analyzer explanation oversimplifies why containers were flagged: M1 has16h and a detailed-description flag, not just rolled-up20–32h. This does not alter saved scope/counts or turn analyzer approval into independent complexity evidence.
Parent milestone gates are represented at milestone level; full automatic scheduling/inherited gate enforcement was not an added requirement.
reviewer: Same coordinator; not independent human or strict methodblind. Full stored task descriptions, mutation calls, analyzer responses and final claims inspected.
